method: Automated inventory read every source, evidence, pathway, profile and review record in the exact manifest candidate for this ISO.

Automated screening compared source references, locators, geography fields, evidence class, direction, status, horizon and scenario; it checked pathway support IDs, link-evidence sets, geography fields, alternatives and uncertainty for follow-up.

Raw extraction access rows are recorded only as inherited access observations. This generated screen does not treat snippets, HTTP success, prior access, or metadata as claim verification and does not replace semantic source review.

verification_summary.limitation: Selected source access and manually adjudicated record-level passages are listed separately. Verification applies only to individually listed claims; all remaining evidence/pathways and the country bank as a whole remain unresolved-limited.

findings: Structural record flags require targeted adjudication; they do not establish that a claim is false.
Automated numeric, programme-language and causal-role screening cues are follow-up prompts only; they are not findings of claim error.

pathways.compact_statement: Climate-related livelihood loss may compound existing exclusion and institutional constraints, increasing displacement or land-tension risks; the evidence does not establish climate-caused violence.
alternative_explanations: Violence, inequality, limited services and economic opportunity independently influence migration and food insecurity.
Tenure disputes and institutional weaknesses are not caused solely by weather.
pathways.uncertainty: Coordinator synthesis combining a historical impact account and a qualitative CCDR warning. No local causal test, quantified probability or event attribution; mechanisms require project-area verification.
recommendations: No structural linkage issue identified; review each cited passage for its specific causal link, alternatives and uncertainty before treating the pathway as verified.

pathways.compact_statement: Honduras evidence finds a stronger rainfall-deficit/migration association in higher-violence departments; the proposed safety constraint is interpretive, not causal proof.
alternative_explanations: Wealth, networks, enforcement/apprehension patterns, poverty, governance and household preferences influence migration.
pathways.uncertainty: Observational aggregate models using department of birth, not necessarily pre-departure residence; author interpretation is not a directly tested household mediation chain.
recommendations: Keep the reverse mechanism bounded to the named institution, population and place supported by its cited evidence; do not infer violence from climate vulnerability.
Retain only evidence whose documented geography supports the pathway location; otherwise narrow the pathway or keep the evidence standalone.
